paper_title: Search for axion-like particles through nuclear Primakoff production using the GlueX detector
coupling_convention: 1/Lambda in GeV^-1 (Leff = (1/4Lambda) a F Fdual, equivalent to g_agamma in GeV^-1)
notes: First search for ALP-photon coupling via nuclear Primakoff production on 12C at GlueX, mass range 200-450 MeV (2e8-4.5e8 eV). Paper reports observed 95% CL limits on 1/Lambda at the O(1 TeV) scale (i.e. ~1e-3 GeV^-1), with the most stringent limit ~1e-3 GeV^-1 at m_a ~ 360 MeV (a downward fluctuation). Numerical values are approximate, read from the description of Fig. 7 (limits span roughly 1e-3 to several e-3 GeV^-1); no table of limit values is provided in the paper. The paper also presents projections for a future 1 fb^-1 lead-target run, which are NOT included here. Not a dark-matter search (accelerator/photoproduction bound), so no DM density assumption.
